_doc: Known structural-failure baseline for the ASHRAE 140 strict +/-15% annual-energy gate (issue #2506, extended in issue #3572 to cover the eight cases 600/800/810/900/920/950/960/970). The Case 600/900 annual COOLING physics gap is NOT yet fixed (tracked by the post-#1323 / #1213 / #1328 cooling-load chain); these two metrics are expected to FAIL the +/-15% band today. The strict-energy-gate workflow runs the eight `#[ignore]`'d strict tests with `--include-ignored`, parses the printed H/C values, computes each metric's gap as a percentage of the band midpoint, and compares against this baseline. The gate FAILS only when a metric REGRESSES beyond `regression_tolerance_pp` percentage points worse than its recorded `gap_pct_of_mid` (or when a previously-`pass` metric starts failing beyond the tolerance). When the physics is fixed and a cooling metric re-enters its band (gap == 0), lower its value here and eventually un-ignore the tests (issues #1333 / #2506 / #3572 acceptance). Do NOT raise a baseline gap to make a regression disappear (RULES.md: no parameter tuning). Updated 2026-09-29 by PR #4265 (Issue #4156): unified HVAC coefficient. Refreshed 2026-09-30 by the PR #4265 follow-up to also reflect the Case 900 H, Case 960 H, and the 13 other per-case measurements not covered by the original PR. The original PR's `value_mwh=3.144, gap_pct_of_mid=65.36` for Case 900 H was internally inconsistent (the gap did not correspond to the value under the standard band_pct_of_mid formula) and has been corrected to the measured 3.723/116.95 pair.
_doc_issue3572: Cases 800 / / 810 are tracked as `known_fail` here even though they lack a formal structural LIMIT entry in docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md (they appear under §Systematic Issues -> HVAC Load Calculation, not as §LIMIT-NN). Per RULES.md ("never raise baselines to hide regressions") we mark the current measured gap as `known_fail` rather than claiming pass; a follow-up PR should add §LIMIT-25 / §LIMIT-26 entries to docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md so the structural rationale is co-located with the failure record. Cases 920 / 950 / 960 / 970 each have a documented LIMIT entry (920 -> §LIMIT-05 UPDATE #2453 cohort, 950 -> -> §LIMIT-17 / §LIMIT-24, 960 -> §LIMIT-14, 970 -> §LIMIT-23).
_rule: Per AGENTS.md / RULES.md: this file records the KNOWN gap; it must never be loosened to hide a regression. Only lower a gap when the engine genuinely improved, and commit the improving change together with the baseline update.
source_path: run_blind_annual_energy() in tests/zone_balance_eplus_isolation.rs (blind zone-balance path, NOT the Informed benchmark.rs path)
_tolerance_fraction_doc: Band edges = midpoint(published_range) * (1 +/- tolerance_fraction). Matches ANNUAL_TOLERANCE_PCT in tests/zone_balance_eplus_isolation.rs.
_regression_tolerance_pp_doc: A metric may get at most this many percentage-points worse (relative to band midpoint) than its recorded gap_pct_of_mid before the gate fails for regression. Absorbs cross-runner numerical noise; tuned for deterministic release builds. A previously-passing metric (gap 0) that drifts outside the band by more than this tolerance ALSO trips the gate.
_doc_issue4170: Issue #4170 (2026-10-09): strict-gate coverage extended to the nine previously-ungated annual cases (610/620/630/640/650/910/930/940/195) and the free-float min/max cohort (600FF/650FF/900FF/950FF, units degC, sign-safe gap formula on |midpoint|). Bands transcribed from src/validation/benchmark.rs published ranges; no band moved. All values measured on the blind Golden-EPW path at develop 21c00103 and recorded downward-only. Judgment calls: (1) Case 640/940 values are byte-identical to Case 600/900 because the blind annual path does not resolve the setback schedule (issue #4167) — recorded as measured, not worked around; (2) Case 630 annual cooling measures IN band on this blind path (3.334 MWh) even though the 600-series test path is over band (4.03, section LIMIT-39) — the two harnesses differ and each records its own value; (3) FF min bands with negative midpoints use distance/|mid| in the checker (ff_gap_pct_of_mid). Correction in the same pass: case_950_cooling's stored published_range/band held Case 900's cooling band ([2.13,3.67]/[2.465,3.335]) — a pre-existing copy error that let any value inside Case 900's band pass; restored to the published Case 950 envelope [0.39,0.92], band [0.557,0.753], matching the Rust CASE_950_REF const.
_doc_window01: UPDATE 2026-10-09 (loop round 7, WINDOW-01): the ASHRAE 140 spec window U-value 3.0 W/m2K is threaded through the CaseSpec path (window_u_value_override; previously the strict path composed the 2.10 W/m2K glazing U + frame bridge to ~2.27 W/m2K effective while the validator setup path set 3.0). All double-clear-window cases re-measured on this branch vs develop 05b93343: low-mass H +12..15% / C -8..10% (e.g. 600 H 5.883->6.758, C 4.700->4.301; 640 H 5.883->6.758; 650 C 3.713->3.508); high-mass H/C +7..8% (900 H 1.566->1.680, C 1.570->1.684; 910/920/930/940 similarly); 800/810 inherit case_600_baseline and move with it; 195/960/970 carry no override and are bit-identical. The doc §19 estimate (+/-2-3% toward reference) is falsified in sign: the physically-correct higher-U window raises winter heating and lowers summer cooling. No tuning; adopted per fidelity-first direction. Free-float strict cases re-measured: 600FF Tmin -18.48?->-19.00/Tmax 57.25->54.87; 650FF Tmin -23.36?->-24.45/Tmax 60.6?->54.37; 900FF Tmin -6.71 (unchanged)->... see values; 950FF Tmin -20.86?->-22.44/Tmax 37.98 (in band, unchanged pass). Paired 600FF under-swing family recorded as measured; nothing tuned. Free-float strict cases re-measured on the branch: 600FF Tmin -18.45 -> -19.00, Tmax 57.25 -> 54.87; 650FF Tmin unchanged (-24.45), Tmax 56.53 -> 54.37; 900FF and 950FF bit-identical (900FF single-clear glazing carries no override; the high-mass 9R4C free-float extremes are insensitive to the low-mass-family window-conductance change). Nothing tuned. Baseline ff gaps recomputed with the gate's sign-safe free-float formula (abs(value-mid)/|mid|). Net band-membership movement: 600FF Tmin leaves its band low (-18.45 in-band -> -19.00, gap 10.47% known_fail); 600FF/650FF Tmax gaps move within tolerance (18.21->21.61, 17.29->20.45, both < 5pp); all other ff metrics unchanged. Honest re-record, no tuning (RULES.md).
